name: 19106 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19106 (Philadelphia) has 227 nonprofit organizations. 140 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19106 (Philadelphia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19106 (Philadelphia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 130 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
